notes.title: [Update 4 + 5] White Targets, Small fixes
notes.notes:
Hello,

there were two patches since the last announcement, and their content was:

- "White Targets" are now "White" (technically they were white before, but they sometimes appeared grey) <- Feedback on the change is appreciated

- Fixed a few typos

- Fixed two wrong symbols on targets in 36


Not much that was changed, but that is a good thing. (Otherwise the game would be pretty broken)

Thanks.

notes.title: [Update 3] #36, Small fixes
notes.notes:
Hello,

there was an Update that fixed the following things:

- Wrong symbols in Room 36
- A Bunch of small fixes (mostly visual stuff)

None of these issues were game-breaking, but they are fixed now.

Thats all for now, thanks.

notes.title: [Update 2] #12, Minor Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello,

There was a patch that fixed:


- A bug in #12 that had to do with the solution.
- Minor text changes
- When launched for the first time the game now displays the borderless resolution correctly (this had no effect on the game, its purely cosmetic)
- prevented people from setting the secondary mouse speed to "0".

This is the last aptch for today, more tomorrow. (There is nothing "broken", just some "wishes" from certain people.)

EDIT: More Achievements will come tomorrow, since it got requested by multiple people now. (I really did not expect that Achievements are that important :P)

Thanks.

notes.title: [Update 1] Achievement Fix, Minor Stuff
notes.notes:
Hello,

As i have announced earlier, here is the patch that fixes:

- "Mirror Mirror" Achievement when you start the game
- "locked menu" when you try to skip the first loading screen
- one missing decorative object in #15

If you still get that achievement when you start your first playthrough, please report it. (This did not happen during testing, and everyone who already has this achievement can not test this since we cant get it a 2nd time.)

Please report anything that looks like a bug, even if you are unsure.
I will make sure to fix everything as fast as possible.

Thank you.

notes.title: Release, Bundle, Sale
notes.notes:
Hello,

[h1]the game is now playable.[/h1]

It has been extensively tested, and there should not be any major issues - at least we have not found one.

If you find a Bug, please report it in the forums so that i can fix it.


[h1]Bundle changes.[/h1]

I changed the existing bundle, so that both ReThink Evolved games are now in it, instead of the old ReThink and the new one.


[h1]Sale for "ReThink Evolved" (the previous game).[/h1]

ReThink Evolved will go on sale tomorrow, for 14 days. (i messed up the date, could not set it to today anymore.)

This game will have 10% off for 7 days.

==========

Thats all for now, please report bugs and leave Feedback.

Have a nice day.
